summary: Verified P0 tasks H3 (VE P&L split_type allocation), H4 (GET /api/expenses/variable/by-retailer + VE Detail Modal), and I (activeRetailers dropdown filter). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_ve_pnl_allocation_h3_h4.py (8 tests, ALL PASSED, XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_43_h3_h4.xml). Seeded VEs of each split_type ('selected','all_equal','proportional') and confirmed: selected split=amount/N for included retailers only (300/2=150), all_equal split=amount/active_count (~20/retailer), proportional returns retailers_included=-1 & retailer_share=0 (calculated by sales). Frontend: E2E via Playwright — logged in as admin, opened Customer P&L for Tamanna Mart (Retail, July 2026), clicked the small eye icon inside the VAR EXP tile which opened the 'Variable Expense Breakdown' modal listing 30+ retail VEs with SPLIT TYPE ('Proportional' green badge), '# RETAILERS' ('By Sales' for proportional), ORIGINAL AMT, YOUR SHARE ('% of sales' for proportional). H3 verified end-to-end: /api/reports/pnl (Jul 2026) returns variable_expenses field for all 11 retail customers (Tamanna=5008.9, Welcome=4914.08 etc., proportional to sales). Part I verified via code review: 5 dropdowns in RetailerOrders.js (Daily Requirement, Invoice, Rejection, Auto-Indent, Closing Inventory) all use activeRetailers.map — churned retailers correctly filtered out. Currently 17 active retailers, 0 churned in DB, so filter is a no-op today but code is correct.

minor.issue: The role query parameter is IGNORED — returns all users (admin+staff+retailer). Client-side filtering needed (activeRetailers useMemo already does .filter(r => r.role === 'retailer' implicitly via status)). Not related to H3/H4/I but worth reporting.

For proportional VEs (which is 100% of current DB), total_share is 0 in the response since proportional shares are computed downstream in /reports/pnl. The frontend modal shows 'Total allocated: ₹0' even when the retailer's actual VAR EXP tile shows ₹5008.9. UX suggestion: also include the proportional share (from /reports/pnl) or label as 'Direct allocation total' to avoid confusion.

issues: 'Total allocated: ₹0' shown at top can confuse users when all expenses are proportional (share is '% of sales' shown per row but not totaled). Consider fetching the proportional_ve share too, or renaming label to 'Direct allocation total'.

action_items: OPTIONAL/UX: Update VE Detail Modal header 'Total allocated' to also include the proportional share (or rename to 'Direct allocation total' + add a row showing 'Proportional share (by sales): ₹X') so users don't see ₹0 when their VAR EXP tile shows a non-zero number.
Verified: Part H3, H4, and I are all working correctly. Main agent can self-test or ship.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/dashboard_analytics.py is 6091 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Should be split into pnl.py, wastage.py, indents.py, dispatches.py etc. This has been called out in prior iterations too.

/app/frontend/src/pages/admin/RetailerOrders.js is 18,440 lines — extremely large. Should be split into RetailerDailyRequirement.js, RetailerIndents.js, RetailerDispatches.js, RetailerInvoices.js, RetailerRejections.js, RetailerCreditNotes.js etc. Well above 700-line guideline.
/app/frontend/src/pages/admin/Dashboard.js is 4073 lines — also over guideline. Split into DashboardOverview.js, CustomerPnLModal.js, VEDetailModal.js, ProductDetailModal.js.

dashboard_analytics.py:1889-1903 (get_active_retailers_on_date) and expenses_new.py:402-413 duplicate the exact same 'active on date' logic. Extract into a shared helper in a common module (e.g., utils/retailers.py) to prevent divergence.

expenses_new.py:407-411 has a subtle bug: `if churned_at[:10] < expense_date_str: continue` — a retailer churned ON the expense date is INCLUDED (churned_at[:10] == expense_date_str is not < , so goes to append). Same in dashboard_analytics.py:1897. Confirm this matches the intended business rule: 'active on the expense date' — currently a retailer churned on 2026-01-15 IS considered active on 2026-01-15. If the intent is 'strictly before' vs 'on-or-before', the current implementation may need a `<=` instead of `<`.

expenses_new.py:398-399: `db.users.find({"role": "retailer"})` — but /api/users?role=retailer query filter is ignored in the HTTP endpoint (returned all roles). If the DB read here is authoritative, fine; but consistency check is worthwhile.

expenses_new.py:432: division-by-zero guard is redundant since preceded by `if retailer_id in selected_retailer_ids` which itself requires the list to be non-empty for the containment check on a non-empty selected_retailer_ids. Not a bug, just dead code.

success_rate.frontend: 3/3 flows (100%) — login, VE Detail modal open, split_type rendering

rca of the issue: No bugs found. All three parts (H3, H4, I) are implemented correctly per spec. Minor UX note: VE Detail Modal shows 'Total allocated: ₹0' when all expenses are proportional (current DB state) which may confuse users seeing a non-zero VAR EXP tile — endpoint intentionally returns 0 for proportional shares since they're computed downstream via sales proportion in /api/reports/pnl. Suggest either summing the proportional share from PnL into the modal total, or renaming the label to 'Direct allocation total' to disambiguate.
